protocol_deviations.description: The amendment required a pre-outcome power or minimum-detectable-effect audit, but no such artifact is present in the verified snapshot.
protocol_deviations.impact: The machine-evaluated endpoint and registered gate remain not_supported because the amendment made power descriptive rather than decision-changing and did not list it as an endpoint-opening hard stop. The omission materially limits the strength of inference from this small pilot and is not repaired post hoc.

interpretation.measured_result: Contextual exposure did not produce the registered positive exposure-by-answerability interaction.
interpretation.answerability_check: Target-bound prompts produced far more answer attempts than code-absent prompts, so the answerability manipulation separated the intended conditions.
plausible_noncausal_explanations: The code-absent cells were near the floor for answer attempts, leaving little room for a positive exposure effect.
The manipulation measured short-term contextual exposure to synthetic names, not general pretrained familiarity.
The 32-unit pilot produced a wide confidence interval and cannot rule out modest effects.
The result may be specific to the synthetic archive-code task or the pinned 2B model.
interpretation.recommended_next_step: Preserve v2 as a negative pilot. Register a new study using unseen units, a pre-outcome power and MDE simulation, development-only calibration that avoids floor and ceiling behavior, and at least one larger or independent model replication.
